opening.argument: The presentation leads with a promise of daily Ethereum earnings through the Infinite Ethereum project, then requires participants to deposit Ethereum to register and activate levels. Its structure is a paid, tiered matrix: each purchased level costs four times the prior level, generates twice the income, and uses network positions whose fifth spot reopens the level. The speaker further says each level generates income “unlimited times with no expiration,” while linking greater earnings to activating more levels. Although the speaker qualifies that income is not guaranteed and effort is required, that disclaimer does not remove the described deposit-and-upgrade mechanism or its repeated return claims.

citations.quote: In the next few minutes, I will show you how you can earn Ethereum daily using the Infinite Ethereum linear project.
deposit enough Ethereum to register and then activate the amount of levels that you want, one by one.
Each level you purchase is four times the value of the previous one and it generates twice the income as well.
Each level generates income unlimited times with no expiration.
income is not guaranteed you need to put in the effort
